notes.title: Version 3.0, Add dance feature, supporting hotkey and voice command of dance
notes.notes:
Add dance functionality, clicking the dance icon in the icon list on the left side of the software main window will switch you to the dance page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/20751b9e2155eef65ac4bae4fdee9e0bfbb5694b.png[/img]

Support voice command to control the character to start dancing: Click the microphone icon on the left side of the software main window, switch to the "Voice Command" page in the upper right corner, click the add button on the right side, select the command type as "dance" from the dropdown in the new voice command, and save. Now you can simply say the voice command "dance" to make the character start dancing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/d7d8f8a0f244d3b742e099027f84d229adc88102.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/3bba98b6532dd8ce9a74fbc75a5b28b19f65eec1.png[/img]


In the software's Settings > Hotkeys section, you can configure shortcuts for starting/stopping dancing, skipping to the next track, going back to the previous track, adjusting the volume, and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/7b9a4f6e7d71c1659e0fbc2b712ae0d88efe109d.png[/img]


At the bottom of the dance page, click the playlist button to create and switch to specific playlists.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/5053782139191f5f796a35e81ed70098ffffe491.png[/img]



Click the Add button at the top of the dance page to create a new dance. For detailed instructions on how to convert and import MMD's VMD dance after transformation, please refer to this comprehensive tutorial with images and videos ：  https://www.bilibili.com/read/cv6004818
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/c466c73c62e707723242c39abc26a278bf196c12.png[/img]

notes.title: Updated to version 2.5, add Jailbreak Mode
notes.notes:
In the DigitalMate settings, switch to the "Jailbreak" page, check the "Enable Jailbreak Mode" option, then input or download the jailbreak main prompt and Jailbreak Prevent Topic Drift Prompt below. This will help you to bypass restrictions and enable unrestricted chatting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/7699db1b8f48384c47199f2a6b672e5868ea0824.png[/img]
